other_failure_modes.name: No validation metric reported
other_failure_modes.description: The script performs cross-validation but completely fails to calculate or report any performance metric (like RMSE) on the validation folds, leaving the user with no estimate of the model's offline generalisation performance.

other_failure_modes.name: Feature leakage before splitting (Frequency Encoding)
other_failure_modes.description: The frequency of categorical variables is calculated on the entire training set prior to cross-validation, leaking feature distribution statistics from the validation folds into the training folds.

summary: The agent implements a reasonable baseline using 5-fold CV with LightGBM and CatBoost, but fails to optimally ensemble them, instead hardcoding a 50/50 blend. Furthermore, the agent never calculates or reports a validation metric during cross-validation, obscuring the model's performance entirely, and introduces minor data leakage by computing frequency encodings across the whole dataset before splitting.
